doc: One entry per product (STANDARDS section 8). 'verified' is written by pipelines/fetch_data.py verify (HTTP GET of the first 4 KB, or STAC collection JSON). 'expect' is the payload kind a download must have (tiff, zip, gzip, json, html for pages). 'filename' is the name used under data/raw/<body>/<site>/. Nothing here is a mosaic. v1.1 (2026-11-14): licence field filled from the provider page or licence text read (see each entry); MODIS LST and Diviner are UNUSED (scope cut, kept, not deleted); gale_ctx_dtm_tile_3_3 added (local extract). v1.2 (2026-11-14): every entry has 'used' (true or false) and 'use' (what the analysis does with it, or why not); PGDA, PDS and LROC licence texts rewritten after the pages were checked that day; globe texture sources (NASA SVS, Wikimedia Commons) added.
